rows.value: Omanis working in another GCC state stay insured with the SPF: 19.5% for old age, disability and death and job security (8% employee, 11.5% employer, the employee paying any shortfall of the host employer); GCC nationals working in Oman stay insured under their home state's law

rows.label: Self-employed Omanis: who is covered and how the contribution counts
rows.value: Covers Omanis working for their own account in crafts such as fishing, agriculture and driving public service vehicles, and those carrying on licensed activities; the contribution paid is converted into a contribution wage by dividing by the total contribution shares (Social Protection Law arts. 70 and 71)
